artifact_audit.scope: Checks result artifact consistency. Model, image, source provenance and external GPU runtime/resource evidence are not verified. Token hashes validate recorded output IDs only and do not establish KV byte correctness. VMM cleanup is checked at the benchmark idle checkpoint. Later per-rank files can include pending reclamation after semantic probes.

static_capacity.derivation: Audited MiniMax pool and allocator code; logical/index capacity is physical pool size times ratio.

notes: Cross-run historical reference, GPU set changed from 0,2,3,4 to0,1,3,4; not simultaneous paired trials.
Small three-repeat sample; shared host CPU activity and clocks not isolated.
GPU observations are periodic, not a reservation; startup/teardown unknown observations retained.
VMM peaks include warmup and probes; NVML measurements are synchronized whole-card sums within timed phases.
Output token hash parity is not a KV byte oracle.
